eligibility.quote: The `link_t-tool0` transform defining the orientation of the `tool0` frame currently specifies only a rotation over Z of `-pi`, but it uses the value `3.1416` for it

failed_conditions.quote:
The `link_t-tool0` transform defining the orientation of the `tool0` frame currently specifies only a rotation over Z of `-pi`, but it uses the value `3.1416` for it ([here](https://github.com/ros-industrial/motoman/blob/e2384f02d926da5b9716fdf915783af31962138c/motoman_sia20d_support/urdf/sia20d_macro.xacro#L188)).

The difference is enough to cause the `base->tool0` transform to be off by as much as 3 degrees wrt to the values reported by the robot.

loudness.quote: The difference is enough to cause the `base->tool0` transform to be off by as much as 3 degrees wrt to the values reported by the robot.

resolution.quote: sia20: don't round PI in joint_t-tool0 transform. Fix #106. Leads to incorrect 'base->tool0' transform orientations.

notes: URDF frame orientation rounding discrepancy on tool0 joint.
